## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 6, 2026 - Aug 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Pwecamp_, Aug 9, 2026, 2/5: "Lately MFP has been suggesting the same meal every day. I don’t want to eat the same thing for five days in a row. Needs to have more recipes. I canceled my subscription because of this limitation. C"
            2. _Nunya77_, Aug 10, 2026, 3/5: "I’ve been using this app for many years and generally find it to be useful. However, I was very disappointed when the ability to scan barcodes was placed behind a paywall. Additionally, the app logs me out randomly and the link to log on using Facebook hasn’t worked in over a year. If you’re not going to fix it just get rid of that option!!!"

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 8, 2026 - Aug 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Azreal743_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "Got the email to renew premium, awesome good to go. They didn’t renew. Now the price online is more than the renewal email they sent me. No way to contact them as the only emails from them are from “no-reply” emails. This platform continues to lose value for the basic things. I don’t care about all this GLP-1 injection nonsense constantly advertised in the app. They had a solid way for me to track my data. I’ve been a premium subscriber for years. Now the updates degrade the user experience, the “ads” in the premium version were pushing GLP injections as “health”, and now they are misleading on renewals. I don’t even know how I could challenge that this could get less customer friendly."
            2. _TbirdieUK_, Aug 9, 2026, 2/5: "Used to be a great app. Now the free tier is unusable due to nonstop pop up ads. Paid is £65/year. Recommend MyNetDiary, free tier much better and paid is £25/year. Interface is at least as good and I think better."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Gonzowiththewind_, Aug 11, 2026, 1/5: "I have not received any help for a syncing issue within the app and it’s been about five days. This app sucks. It’s so annoying. I need this fixed."
            2. _anjamaresak_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "I used & paid for this app for years. This upgrade made it completely unusable. It’s a shame all the new users have NO IDEA how great this used to be."
            3. _sooooooppphhhhiiiiaaaaa_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "Im never one to leave a bad review. But the update sucks. I have used MFP for over a decade and this is what is finally gonna be pushing me to search for another app. The new update makes tracking 10x more complicated and slows it down. Why change something that wasn’t broken? Why not listen to thousand of dissatisfied longtime users? Please give us an option to revert back."
<!--/ir-theme-->
